research_notes: A production relay can later use recent runtime-health evidence to temporarily lower cap during degraded conditions.
This is a rollback mechanism, not necessarily a continuously adaptive cap.
Keeping normal cap changes infrequent reduces instability and makes failures easier to diagnose.
Only repeated evidence should promote a higher cap again after rollback.
This asymmetry—fast safety rollback, slower promotion—is appropriate for continuation-critical work.
Current Phase A only discovers the candidate envelope.
